```{r, set-up, include=FALSE}
library(data.table)

library(DT)

library(knitr)
library(here)

library(RColorBrewer)

source(here("functions/subchunkify.R"))

dt_options1 <- list(
      dom = 'ft',
      paging = FALSE,
      searching = FALSE,
      pageLength = 500,
      columnDefs = list(list(className = 'dt-center', targets = "_all"))
)

dt_options2 <- list(
      dom = 'Bft',
      paging = FALSE,
      searching = TRUE,
      pageLength = 500,
      scrollY = "500px",
      scrollX = "500px",
      columnDefs = list(list(className = 'dt-center', targets = "_all")),
      buttons = c('copy', 'csv')
)

region_param <- params$region_param
depl_file <- params$depl_file

grossrange_table_path <- "C:/Users/Danielle Dempsey/Desktop/RProjects/nb_cmp/nb_water_quality_reports/nb_thresholds.xlsx"

path_out <- file.path("R:/data_branches/nb_water_quality/processed_data")

file_name <- sub(".*/", "", depl_file, perl = TRUE)

```


```{r}
#| label: apply-qc-tests
#| include: false

dat_raw <- readRDS(depl_file)

station <- unique(dat_raw$station)
depl_range <- unique(dat_raw$deployment_range)

vars <- dat_raw %>% 
  ss_pivot_longer() %>% 
  distinct(variable)
vars <- sort(vars$variable)

# if sensor depth was not measured, do not run qc_test_depth_crosscheck
if("sensor_depth_measured_m" %in% vars) {
  qc_tests <- c("grossrange", "depth_crosscheck")
} else{
  qc_tests <- "grossrange"
}

grossrange_table <- read_excel(grossrange_table_path) %>% 
  select(-rationale) %>% 
  pivot_wider(values_from = "threshold_value", names_from = "threshold")

user_thresh <- grossrange_table %>%
  select(variable, contains("user")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(user_min) & !is.na(user_max)) 

sensor_thresh <- grossrange_table %>%
  select(sensor_type, variable, contains("sensor")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(sensor_type))

grossrange_table <- sensor_thresh %>%
  inner_join(user_thresh, by = "variable")

# assign flags - qc tests
dat <- dat_raw %>% 
  rename(county = region) %>% 
  qc_test_all(
    qc_tests = qc_tests,
    grossrange_table = grossrange_table
  ) 

if (nrow(dat) != nrow(dat_raw)) knitr::knit_exit()

# use to make qc_summary and figures
dat_long <- dat %>%
  qc_pivot_longer(qc_tests = qc_tests)

# # export
qc_summary <- dat_long %>%
  qc_summarise_flags() %>%
  mutate(
    station = station,
    deployment_range = depl_range
  ) %>%
  select(station, deployment_range, everything()) %>%
  filter(
    !(qc_test == "climatology" &
        (variable == "salinity_psu" | variable == "sensor_depth_measured_m"))
  )

#################################################################
#### EXPORT ####################################################

dat %>% 
  rename(region = county) %>% 
  saveRDS(paste(path_out, "qc_data", region_param, "new", file_name, sep = "/"))

#fwrite(qc_summary,
          # paste(path_out, "qc_data/qc_flag_summary.csv", sep = "/"),
          # append = TRUE)

###############################################################
###############################################################

```

# QC Figures

```{r} 
#| message: FALSE
#| results: asis

if("sensor_depth_measured_m" %in% vars) {

  cat('\n## depth_crosscheck\n')

  # height of figure
  n_sensor <- dat_long %>%
    filter(variable == "sensor_depth_measured_m" & !is.na(value)) %>%
    distinct(sensor_serial_number)
  n_sensor <- nrow(n_sensor)

  if(n_sensor == 1) h = 2.75
  if(n_sensor > 1) h = 2.75 * n_sensor

  p <- qc_plot_flags(dat_long, qc_tests = "depth_crosscheck", ncol = 1)

  subchunkify(p$depth_crosscheck, fig_height = h, fig_width = 8.5)

  qc_tests <- qc_tests[-which(qc_tests == "depth_crosscheck")]

}

for(i in seq_along(vars)){

  var_i <- vars[i]

  cat('\n##', var_i)

  for(j in seq_along(qc_tests)) {

    test_j <- qc_tests[j]

    # climatology test not applied to these variables
    if(!(test_j == "climatology" &
         (var_i == "salinity_psu" | var_i == "sensor_depth_measured_m"))) {

      if(test_j == "qc") {
         cat('\n### summary flags\n')
      } else cat('\n###', test_j, '\n')

      # subset data to variable of interest
      dat_j <- dat_long %>%
        filter(variable == var_i)

      # height of figure j
      n_sensor <- length(unique(dat_j$sensor_serial_number))

      if(n_sensor == 1) h = 2.25
      if(n_sensor > 1) h = 2.25 * n_sensor

      p <- qc_plot_flags(dat_j, qc_tests = test_j, ncol = 1, flag_title = FALSE)

      subchunkify(p[[1]][[1]], fig_height = h, fig_width = 8.5)

    }
  }
}

```
